sentence: This project builds methods that combine medical imaging, clinical records, and genetic information and shows how sure the results are.
This project builds a soft robotic antenna made of stretchable materials and liquid metal that changes shape to suit different operating frequencies.
This project studies how a soft robot arm can respond to touch on its own, so it can avoid damage and grasp objects.
This project studies how private information can leak between people who share a graphics processing unit in the cloud, and builds countermeasures.
This project studies how to make trusted execution environments in embedded devices more trustworthy, and looks for and fixes weaknesses in their software.
This project uses bioengineered microtissues on a chip to study how blood vessel growth becomes abnormal in diseases such as cancer.
This project builds a software tool that uses artificial intelligence to link versions of genes to plant growth in different climates.
This project builds courses and an online certificate that teach cybersecurity and data science for small business risks in community colleges.
This project builds machine learning tools that find signs of balancing selection, a process that keeps genetic diversity, in missing or degraded DNA sequence data.
This project studies how the nitrogen in ammonia reacts with metal surfaces during burning, using laser diagnostics and a computer model.
This project studies how sunlight breaks down petroleum and releases heavy metals, and how those metals change and affect life in water.
This project studies how wild capuchin monkeys in two forests respond to stress and whether those responses help or harm their health.
This project builds a microfluidic device that mimics the hormonal and mechanical environment of plant cells.
This project builds a computing system that lets researchers use sensitive data while tools such as differential privacy and federated learning protect it.
This project studies how to move many nano-sized objects independently, each on its own, using shared external electric fields in microfluidic environments.
This project studies how Salmonella uses small RNA molecules and different sigma subunits to decide between resisting stress and going dormant.
